title: Packing for the Road

intro.speaker: tobias
intro.text: I'm taking my bread cart along the coast road this week, to the mill and the harbour! It's a long way on foot.

intro.speaker: tobias
intro.text: Here's my list of what to pack. Will you read it, and load just what it says?

steps.speaker: tobias
steps.prompt: Read the list. Put the right things in the cart, then press Done.

older.prompt: Read the list: no pictures this time. Put the right things in the cart, then press Done.

feedback.all_good: Just right! Enough to share with everyone I meet on the way.

outro.speaker: tobias
outro.text: Loaded and ready! A walker should always carry a little extra, to share with whoever they meet.

journal_line: I packed Mr. Tobias's cart for a journey along the coast road.
